description: Who a collection or a place is the sum of, and how. A roll-up reads its members as they are before any roll-up, is never a root and never spreads.

records.description: The site is the worst of everything on it that is not itself a sum.
A cluster, an environment or a group is the worst of its members and what serves it.
A room or a rack is the worst of what is placed in it and the nodes its assets are allocated to.
An environment's vulnerability is its own risk score, not the worst of its members; the modules that set it are the roots.
A zone's vulnerability is its own risk score, the sum of its modules': never a root.
